description: This file defines the CaptionOverlayActivity class, an Android activity that overlays a caption on content, manages window caption styles, and handles caption area changes via a listener.

classes.name: CaptionOverlayActivity
classes.description: An Android activity providing a caption overlay on content and managing window caption behavior, including handling caption area changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets content view, configures window caption styles, hides the status bar and action bar.

methods.name: onRestrictedCaptionAreaChanged
methods.description: Callback method invoked when the restricted caption area changes; logs the new rectangle.
